detail: Many of the 362 owed writers of fn-owner-served-carried are (value X) readers: they return (mv nil X state) with state unchanged (e.g. fn-owner-feed-host/-port/-security, fn-owner-proxy-step, fn-owner-orcp-salt, fn-store-sn-sweep-round, fn-owner-retire-step). A :program function can carry no preservation theorem, but a function that does not return state is not a writer at all. Fix: return the value without state (definterface signature and native callers adapted), regenerate the owed list, and the names leave it with no proof. Survey first: classify each owed :program name as read-only or writing by its body (a tail call into a state writer is a writer). Not inside K1 (coordinator).
